symembed: polynomial closure of the Bursarial outputs (generated by
symembed/explore/polynomial_closure.py; do not edit by hand).

An output is KEPT unless it is an exact polynomial in outputs already kept (visited in order c, j), then
kept outputs are retried against the others (backward pruning). Setting 'w': formal polynomials in the
d's and e's. Setting 'L': polynomials in vector components, where the Gram/Plucker relations hold. Every
identity was verified exactly. 'Ec,j' means E_{c,j}. Each case is run for the plain Bursarial embedding
and for involution packing (embedder bursar_involution).

  S(3) acting on (a, b, c), k = 2            quotient dim 5:  bursar 174 -> 32 -> 13;  bursar_involution 90 -> 58 -> 13
  S(2) x S(1) acting on (a, b, p), k = 2     quotient dim 5:  bursar 26 -> 15 -> 11;  bursar_involution 14 -> 12 -> 11
  S(2) acting on (a, b), k = 1               quotient dim 2:  bursar 14 -> 6 -> 2;  bursar_involution 8 -> 6 -> 2
  S(3) acting on (a, b, c), k = 1            quotient dim 3:  bursar 174 -> 21 -> 5;  bursar_involution 111 -> 24 -> 5
  S(2) x S(1) acting on (a, b, p), k = 1     quotient dim 3:  bursar 26 -> 12 -> 3;  bursar_involution 17 -> 11 -> 3
